description: List input prices, USD per million input tokens, that price the frames a Make it postable plan sends to an API-key connector (ADR-R48, doc/spec/ai.md section 19.6). The tokens are the frame sheet's estimate (Anthropic's width x height / 750 per image) for every provider. A model not listed takes its connector's highest listed price, so the estimate never reads low; a connector not listed is unpriced and its billed sends carry the text summary only. Read from each provider's public pricing page on the date in checked; prompts of a clip plan stay far below every long-context tier, so the short-context price is listed. Promotional prices are replaced by the regular one where the page names it (gemini-3.8-flash).
